title: Over-engineered on purpose.
body_1: Offshore casting rods are commonly built around accepted compromises. KAIZURO is being developed by questioning each of them—from grip geometry and guide architecture to blank recovery, load control and component weight.
principles_text:
Remove Compromise. Every component must justify its weight, geometry and function.

Prove the Structure. Physical prototype testing informs every meaningful decision.

Refine Relentlessly. Test, learn, correct and repeat until the complete system performs as intended
